title: Discovering Christian Science in Philadelphia
summary: Seeking a church, he is advised to see a practitioner, who explains the Comforter promised in John.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Now, the next thing that happened to me I think that made a change in my life...
Well, this is what you'd give to the young people for advice.
Right. I took up the study of Christian Science. We were in Philadelphia, and I was looking for a

church to go to that Sunday, so the lady advised me (this is after I was a young student) the first thing I should do was to go and see a practitioner. She says, "They won't help you in healing, but they'll help you in understanding what Christian Science is all about.

A practitioner is one who has studied... He has gone from what you call class... It is similar to what they taught the disciples. You know, Jesus taught twelve disciples. He took them off on their own and taught the twelve. At one time he taught seventy, and twelve was special. And Christian Science tries to emulate that in teaching you the facts concerning what the master meant by what he taught.

See, the whole premise of Christian Science is built on that 14th Chapter... It's in the 14th Chapter of John, the 16th Verse, and he says that later on there will a comforter. who will come and give us the whole truth. Because Jesus wasn't giving his disciples the whole truth. He was only giving them what they could understand, you know. They didn't all understand it. I used to always think that the one that really understood him precisely was John.
Yeah, it's my personal thing. Because John had a great sense... John's something similar to you. He has a real sense of recall.
